Reliance Power (Anil Ambani / ADAG) is not Reliance Industries (Mukesh Ambani).
Reliance Group (Anil Dhirubhai Ambani) is not the Reliance Industries promoter group (Mukesh Ambani).
Reliance Infrastructure (BSES; ADAG) is not RIL.
Brothers; different persons, different groups.

Torrent Pharma (co:torrent-pharmaceuticals) is a third, distinct entity. The oilgas.json record, which described the group, now carries id energy:torrent-group, and oilgas:c054 (group ₹137 cr to BJP) now starts at energy:torrent-group, so it is not added to Torrent Power Ltd's own documented ₹106.5 cr / ₹76 cr to BJP (grid:c104, grid:c105).
Jaiprakash Associates Ltd and Jaiprakash Power Ventures Ltd are separate listed Jaypee companies.
Different Reddys: Gali Janardhana Reddy (Karnataka minister, Bellary mining) vs G. Kishan Reddy (Union Minister of Coal and Mines, Secunderabad MP).

Different Reddys: Y. S. Jagan Mohan Reddy (AP CM 2019–24) vs P. V. Krishna Reddy (MD, MEIL); likewise energy:pp-reddy (MEIL chairman), sarath (P. Sarath Chandra Reddy, Aurobindo) and energy:s-jaipal-reddy (Petroleum Minister) are five distinct persons.
Different Singhs: R. K. Singh (Minister of Power 2017–24, Arrah MP) vs Jitendra Singh (MoS, Department of Atomic Energy); energy:manmohan-singh (PM 2004–14) is a third.
Adani Power (Jharkhand) Ltd (Godda plant) is a subsidiary with its own PPA with BPDB; likewise energy:mahan-energen. Subsidiaries are separate nodes.
Utkal Alumina International is a Hindalco subsidiary, a separate legal entity.
The state government and its three distribution companies (and energy:apspdcl) are separate counterparties in the SECI PSA and PPA records.
The firm vs its report (a literature document node).
The court vs the prosecutor (US DOJ/SEC).
Two ministries; the Atlas `coal` node that combines them under Joshi 2019–24 was not used as the target of the literature mapping for that reason.
